claims.text: The dataset consists of more than 70,000 US English phone conversations, each averaging 11 minutes in duration.
The dataset includes an intent library with 313 intents, each expressed with an average of 169 examples.
A sampled dataset of 500 rescored intent annotations was used for evaluation in the cancellations and refunds domain.
